name: 28739 · Hendersonvlle, NC
findings: ZIP 28739 (Hendersonvlle) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28739 (Hendersonvlle) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
